name: a refused create writes a notice with its content and the refusal detail
a queued update of the refused create is folded into its notice; an unrelated entry stays
a refused command folds a lap naming its predicted run, that lap's own update, and a command naming the run
a refused tag create folds a link keyed by it and a mark in another scope keyed by it
a refused board create folds every write to the scopes it would govern
a partly dependent entry loses the dependent delta and its guards and keeps the rest
a sent dependent becomes an orphan held in the notice, and its refusal ends it without a notice of its own
an orphan the server admits is acked like any ok, and its content stays in the notice
a sent entry partly dependent is an orphan: the refused create's notice holds its whole content, and its own refusal ends it without a notice
a refused tag create in one tree folds nothing of a same-id tag or mark in another tree
an orphan's refusal folds its held-back dependents into the origin's notice: an edit of the record the orphan created is never sent
an orphan the server admits releases its held-back dependents: a ready and a held edit of the record it created both land
a dismissed notice is kept, hidden
a guard on a register a held-back update of a held create wrote names its stamp: the undo empties the update, and the guarding entry is refused stale
content folding into a dismissed notice shows it again: an orphan's refusal folds its held-back dependent there
an orphan that outgrew a request alone ends without a notice of its own, and its held-back dependent folds into the origin's notice
the refusal of an outgrown orphan frees what it held back: a partly dependent entry keeps its own part, and an entry held back behind it is numbered in the same push
